title: Gerunds and infinitives advanced
note: verbs where -ing and to + infinitive change the meaning: stop / go on · remember / forget · try / mean / need · plus a choose-the-verb strand that teaches remember, forget, regret, mean themselves · 4 strands x 12 · 48 items · built to live 2026-08-07 (cloud run 8)

items.en: I stopped smoking last year.
accepts: I stopped smoking last year.
items.explanation: stop + -ing = the activity ended. This is what he no longer does.
items.explanation_cz: stop + -ing = činnost skončila. Tohle už nedělá.

items.en: I stopped to buy a ticket.
items.cz: Zastavil jsem se, abych si koupil lístek.
accepts: I stopped to buy a ticket.
items.explanation: stop + to = you stopped in order to do something else. Two different actions.
items.explanation_cz: stop + to = zastavil jsem se, abych něco udělal. Dva různé děje.

items.en: She stopped working at six.
accepts: She stopped working at six.
items.explanation: The work is what stopped, so it takes -ing.
items.explanation_cz: Skončila samotná práce, proto -ing.

items.en: He stopped to check the map.
accepts: He stopped to check the map.
items.explanation: He did not stop checking — he stopped in order to check.
items.explanation_cz: Nepřestal kontrolovat — zastavil se, aby zkontroloval.

items.en: We stopped using the old laptop.
accepts: We stopped using the old laptop.
items.explanation: stop + -ing again: the using came to an end.
items.explanation_cz: Zase stop + -ing: používání skončilo.

items.en: We stopped to look at the bridge.
items.cz: Zastavili jsme se, abychom se podívali na most.
items.gap: We stopped ____ look at the bridge.
accepts: We stopped to look at the bridge.
items.explanation: The purpose reading always uses to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: Význam „za účelem“ má vždy to + infinitiv.

items.en: Stop worrying about the exam.
items.cz: Přestaň se bát o tu zkoušku.
accepts: Stop worrying about the exam.
items.explanation: An order works the same way: stop + -ing ends the activity.
items.explanation_cz: Rozkaz funguje stejně: stop + -ing ukončí činnost.

items.en: He stopped coming to the meetings.
accepts: He stopped coming to the meetings.
items.explanation: stop + -ing describes a habit that finished.
items.explanation_cz: stop + -ing popisuje zvyk, který skončil.

items.en: He went on reading for an hour.
items.gap: He went on ____ for an hour.
accepts: He went on reading for an hour.
items.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity, without a break.
items.explanation_cz: go on + -ing = pokračovat ve stejné činnosti, bez přerušení.

items.en: After the meeting she went on to explain the contract.
items.cz: Po schůzce pak přešla k vysvětlení smlouvy.
items.gap: After the meeting she went on ____ explain the contract.
accepts: After the meeting she went on to explain the contract.
items.explanation: go on + to = move on to the next, different thing.
items.explanation_cz: go on + to = přejít k další, jiné věci.

items.en: They went on working after six.
accepts: They went on working after six.
items.explanation: Same activity continuing, so -ing.
items.explanation_cz: Pokračuje stejná činnost, proto -ing.

items.en: She went on to work in London.
items.gap: She went on ____ work in London.
accepts: She went on to work in London.
items.explanation: A new stage in the story: go on + to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: Nová etapa v příběhu: go on + to + infinitiv.

items.en: Remember to lock the door.
accepts: Remember to lock the door.
items.explanation: remember + to = a duty still in front of you. Do not forget to do it.
items.explanation_cz: remember + to = povinnost, která tě teprve čeká. Nezapomeň to udělat.

items.en: I remember locking the door.
items.cz: Pamatuju si, že jsem dveře zamykal.
accepts: I remember locking the door.
items.explanation: remember + -ing = a memory of something already done.
items.explanation_cz: remember + -ing = vzpomínka na něco, co už se stalo.

items.en: Remember to pay the bill.
accepts: Remember to pay the bill.
items.explanation: Still to be done, so to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: Ještě to čeká, proto to + infinitiv.

items.en: I remember paying the bill.
items.cz: Pamatuju si, že jsem ten účet platil.
accepts: I remember paying the bill.
items.explanation: Already done and stored in memory, so -ing.
items.explanation_cz: Už hotovo a uloženo ve vzpomínce, proto -ing.

items.en: She remembers visiting the museum as a child.
items.cz: Pamatuje si, že jako dítě navštívila to muzeum.
items.gap: She remembers ____ the museum as a child.
accepts: She remembers visiting the museum as a child.
items.explanation: Childhood memories are always the -ing pattern.
items.explanation_cz: Vzpomínky z dětství mají vždy vazbu s -ing.

items.en: Please remember to send the contract.
accepts: Please remember to send the contract.
items.explanation: A polite reminder about a future job: remember + to.
items.explanation_cz: Zdvořilá připomínka budoucího úkolu: remember + to.

items.en: Don't forget to book a hotel.
accepts: Don't forget to book a hotel.
Do not forget to book a hotel.
items.explanation: forget + to works like remember + to: a job you must not miss.
items.explanation_cz: forget + to funguje jako remember + to: úkol, který nesmíš vynechat.

items.en: I will never forget meeting her.
items.cz: Nikdy nezapomenu, jak jsem ji potkal.
accepts: I will never forget meeting her.
I'll never forget meeting her.
items.explanation: forget + -ing = the experience itself, which you keep.
items.explanation_cz: forget + -ing = samotný zážitek, který si člověk nese.

items.en: He forgets to check his phone.
accepts: He forgets to check his phone.
She forgets to check her phone.
items.explanation: A duty he keeps missing: forget + to.
items.explanation_cz: Povinnost, na kterou pořád zapomíná: forget + to.

items.en: She remembers working in that shop.
items.cz: Pamatuje si, jak v tom obchodě pracovala.
accepts: She remembers working in that shop.
items.explanation: Past experience, not a future duty.
items.explanation_cz: Zážitek z minulosti, ne budoucí povinnost.

items.en: Remember to close the windows.
accepts: Remember to close the windows.
items.explanation: Instructions before you leave: remember + to.
items.explanation_cz: Pokyny před odchodem: remember + to.

items.en: I remember posting the letter.
items.cz: Pamatuju si, že jsem ten dopis podal.
accepts: I remember posting the letter.
items.explanation: Czech uses a že-clause here; English uses the -ing form.
items.explanation_cz: Čeština tu použije větu se „že“; angličtina používá -ing tvar.

items.en: Try opening a window.
accepts: Try opening a window.
items.explanation: try + -ing = an experiment. It is easy; you are testing whether it helps.
items.explanation_cz: try + -ing = pokus. Je to snadné; jen zkoušíš, jestli to pomůže.

items.en: Try to open the window.
items.cz: Snaž se to okno otevřít. (je to těžké)
accepts: Try to open the window.
items.explanation: try + to = effort against difficulty. It may not work.
items.explanation_cz: try + to = snaha proti obtížím. Nemusí se to povést.

items.en: Try phoning the office first.
accepts: Try phoning the office first.
items.explanation: One of several things you could test.
items.explanation_cz: Jedna z několika věcí, které můžeš vyzkoušet.

items.en: She tried to finish the report before six.
items.cz: Snažila se dokončit tu zprávu před šestou.
items.gap: She tried ____ finish the report before six.
accepts: She tried to finish the report before six.
items.explanation: Real effort, and the sentence leaves open whether she managed it.
items.explanation_cz: Skutečná snaha; věta nechává otevřené, jestli to zvládla.

items.en: Try using a bigger cup.
accepts: Try using a bigger cup.
items.explanation: Advice: test this and see.
items.explanation_cz: Rada: vyzkoušej to a uvidíš.

items.en: He tried to explain the mistake.
accepts: He tried to explain the mistake.
items.explanation: Difficult, so try + to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: Je to těžké, proto try + to + infinitiv.

items.en: It means working late again.
accepts: It means working late again.
items.explanation: mean + -ing = it involves this, as a result.
items.explanation_cz: mean + -ing = má to za následek tohle.

items.en: I meant to call you yesterday.
accepts: I meant to call you yesterday.
items.explanation: mean + to = intend. The intention was there; the call was not.
items.explanation_cz: mean + to = mít v úmyslu. Úmysl byl; hovor ne.

items.en: Moving to Brno means changing schools.
items.cz: Stěhování do Brna znamená změnu školy.
accepts: Moving to Brno means changing schools.
items.explanation: A consequence, so -ing follows mean.
items.explanation_cz: Důsledek, proto po mean následuje -ing.

items.en: The car needs cleaning.
accepts: The car needs cleaning.
items.explanation: need + -ing has a passive sense: it needs to be cleaned. The car does nothing.
items.explanation_cz: need + -ing má trpný význam: potřebuje být umyté. Auto samo nic nedělá.

items.en: You need to clean the car.
accepts: You need to clean the car.
items.explanation: With a person doing the work, need takes to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: Když práci dělá člověk, need má to + infinitiv.

items.en: The windows need washing.
accepts: The windows need washing.
items.explanation: Same passive sense: the windows need to be washed.
items.explanation_cz: Stejný trpný význam: okna potřebují být umytá.

items.en: I remember locking the office, but I am not sure.
items.cz: Pamatuju si, že jsem kancelář zamykal, ale nejsem si jistý.
items.gap: I ____ locking the office, but I am not sure.
accepts: I remember locking the office, but I am not sure.
I remember locking the office, but i'm not sure.
items.explanation: remember + -ing looks back at something you did.
items.explanation_cz: remember + -ing se ohlíží za něčím, co jsi udělal.

items.en: Don't forget to bring your passport.
accepts: Don't forget to bring your passport.
Do not forget to bring your passport.
items.explanation: Don't forget to … is the standard warning about a future duty.
items.explanation_cz: Don't forget to … je běžné varování před budoucí povinností.

items.en: I regret leaving that job.
items.cz: Lituju, že jsem tu práci opustil.
accepts: I regret leaving that job.
items.explanation: regret + -ing = you are sorry about something already done.
items.explanation_cz: regret + -ing = je ti líto něčeho, co už se stalo.

items.en: We regret to cancel the meeting.
accepts: We regret to cancel the meeting.
items.explanation: regret + to + infinitive introduces bad news, formally, as you give it.
items.explanation_cz: regret + to + infinitiv formálně uvádí špatnou zprávu ve chvíli, kdy ji sdělujete.

items.en: I meant to send the contract on Monday.
items.cz: Chtěl jsem tu smlouvu poslat v pondělí.
items.gap: I ____ to send the contract on Monday.
accepts: I meant to send the contract on Monday.
items.explanation: meant is the past of mean. mean + to = intend.
items.explanation_cz: meant je minulý tvar od mean. mean + to = mít v úmyslu.

items.en: A new job means moving to another city.
items.cz: Nová práce znamená stěhování do jiného města.
items.gap: A new job ____ moving to another city.
accepts: A new job means moving to another city.
items.explanation: mean + -ing = involve, as a consequence.
items.explanation_cz: mean + -ing = mít za následek.

items.en: Please stop making that noise.
accepts: Please stop making that noise.
items.explanation: stop + -ing ends an activity that is happening now.
items.explanation_cz: stop + -ing ukončí činnost, která právě probíhá.

items.en: Try starting the car again.
accepts: Try starting the car again.
items.explanation: try + -ing offers something to test.
items.explanation_cz: try + -ing nabízí něco k vyzkoušení.

items.en: The heating needs checking before winter.
items.cz: Topení je potřeba před zimou zkontrolovat.
accepts: The heating needs checking before winter.
items.explanation: need + -ing: the heating is not doing the checking.
items.explanation_cz: need + -ing: topení samo nic nekontroluje.

items.en: She went on to manage the shop.
items.gap: She ____ on to manage the shop.
accepts: She went on to manage the shop.
items.explanation: go on + to + infinitive moves the story to its next stage.
items.explanation_cz: go on + to + infinitiv posouvá vyprávění do další fáze.

items.en: I forget to check my messages.
accepts: I forget to check my messages.
items.explanation: forget + to = you keep missing a duty.
items.explanation_cz: forget + to = pořád zapomínáš na povinnost.

items.en: Do you remember to take your keys?
items.gap: Do you ____ to take your keys?
accepts: Do you remember to take your keys?
items.explanation: remember + to asks about a duty, not a memory.
items.explanation_cz: remember + to se ptá na povinnost, ne na vzpomínku.

cards.title: A small group of verbs where the choice changes the meaning
cards.title_cz: Malá skupina sloves, kde volba mění význam
cards.body: Most verbs simply take one pattern or the other and you learn it. This unit is about the **handful where both are correct and mean different things**. Getting it wrong does not sound broken — it says something you did not mean, which is worse.
cards.body_cz: Většina sloves prostě má jednu nebo druhou vazbu a tu se člověk naučí. Tahle lekce je o **hrstce sloves, kde jsou správné obě a znamenají něco jiného**. Chyba tu nezní jako chyba — řekne něco jiného, než jste chtěli, což je horší.

table.caption: The core pairs
rows: you stopped in order to do it
move on to the next thing

cards.title: stop: one action ends, or one action starts
cards.title_cz: stop: buď jeden děj končí, nebo jeden začíná
cards.body: With **-ing** there is only one activity and it finishes. With **to** there are **two** activities: you break off what you were doing so that you can do something else. The Czech translations are not even close to each other.
cards.body_cz: S **-ing** je tu jen jedna činnost a ta končí. S **to** jsou činnosti **dvě**: přerušíte to, co jste dělali, abyste mohli udělat něco jiného. České překlady si nejsou vůbec podobné.
points: I stopped **smoking**. → I do not smoke any more.
I stopped **to smoke**. → I broke off what I was doing and had a cigarette.
He went on **reading**. → he carried on with the same book.
He went on **to explain** the contract. → next he explained it.

cards.title: remember and forget: backwards or forwards
cards.title_cz: remember a forget: dozadu, nebo dopředu
cards.body: **-ing points backwards** at something already done; **to points forwards** at something still to do. A useful check: if you could add *that I …* in Czech, English wants **-ing**; if it is an instruction or a reminder, English wants **to**.
cards.body_cz: **-ing ukazuje dozadu** na něco, co už se stalo; **to ukazuje dopředu** na to, co teprve čeká. Užitečná zkouška: pokud byste v češtině mohli přidat „že jsem…“, angličtina chce **-ing**; pokud jde o pokyn nebo připomínku, chce **to**.
points: I remember **locking** the door. → I did it, and I can picture it.
Remember **to lock** the door. → do it, please.
I will never forget **meeting** her. → the memory stays.
Don't forget **to book** a hotel. → the job is still waiting.

cards.title: try, mean, need
cards.body: **try + -ing** is cheap — test it and see. **try + to** implies the thing is hard and may fail. **mean + -ing** states a consequence, **mean + to** an intention. **need + -ing** is the one that surprises Czech learners: it is **passive in meaning**, with no *be* anywhere.
cards.body_cz: **try + -ing** nic nestojí — vyzkoušej a uvidíš. **try + to** naznačuje, že je to těžké a může to selhat. **mean + -ing** říká důsledek, **mean + to** úmysl. **need + -ing** české studenty překvapuje: má **trpný význam**, a přitom tam žádné *be* není.
points: Try **opening** a window. (maybe that helps) · Try **to open** it. (it is stuck)
It means **working** late. (result) · I meant **to call** you. (intention)
The car needs **cleaning**. = the car needs to be cleaned.
You need **to clean** the car. → here a person does the work.

rows: I stopped **to smoke** last year. (= I paused for a cigarette)
Remember **locking** the door before you leave.
Remember **to lock** the door before you leave.
I remember **to lock** it — I can picture it.
I remember **locking** it — I can picture it.
We regret **cancelling** the meeting. (as you announce it)
